runtime.methodology: Synthetic deterministic hill; shipping AI, LOS, objective/security, navigation and physical movement. Render-only hooks omitted. No hidden enemy knowledge injected.
notes: Natural shipping victory accounting stops controlled trials; missing checkpoints are not sampled after victory.
